gloss: to adhere; to bond; to glue together; to stick

definitions.gloss: to adhere; to bond; to glue together; to stick
definitions.explanation: to adhere; to bond; to glue together; to stick

examples.japanese: {部品|ぶひん}を{接着|せっちゃく}する。
{壊|こわ}れた{花瓶|かびん}を{接着剤|せっちゃくざい}で{接着|せっちゃく}した。
examples.english: I glued the broken vase back together with adhesive.

examples.japanese: この{素材|そざい}は{熱|ねつ}を{加|くわ}えると{接着|せっちゃく}する{性質|せいしつ}がある。
examples.english: This material has the property of bonding when heat is applied.

examples.japanese: {タイル|たいる}がしっかり{接着|せっちゃく}していないと、{剥|は}がれてしまう。
examples.english: If the tiles aren't firmly bonded, they'll come off.

notes:
Refers to making two surfaces stick together, either with adhesive or through a bonding process. Used in both everyday (craft, repair) and industrial/technical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {接着剤|せっちゃくざい}: adhesive; glue
- {接着|せっちゃく}テープ: adhesive tape
- {接着|せっちゃく}{面|めん}: bonding surface
- {接着|せっちゃく}{強度|きょうど}: adhesive strength
- {接着|せっちゃく}{力|りょく}: bonding power

SIMILAR WORDS:
- くっつける: to stick; to attach — a more colloquial, everyday word for sticking things together
- {貼|は}る: to paste; to affix — used for putting stickers, labels, or wallpaper on a surface
- {固定|こてい}する: to fix; to secure — focuses on holding something in place, not necessarily through adhesion
